verdict.rationale: Jitsu supports a 'webhook' destination that pushes event data to any HTTP endpoint (Slack, Discord, custom URLs) and has real-time Slack/Email alerts for sync/job failures, which functions as an event-subscription mechanism, but this is framed as a data destination/notification feature rather than a dedicated webhook subscription API for programmatic consumers. Missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription API docs (signing, retries, event-type filtering), and any AI-native framing or first-party example of an agent subscribing to pipeline events via webhook.
